info.name: NexHealth Adjustment Types Available Slots API

params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: start_date
params.description: Date string you want results to start at, format YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to include, counting the start date. For best performance, this value should not exceed 14 days.

params.name: appointment_type_id
params.description: Specify an appointment type to filter returned slots and set slot_length to appointment_type.minutes

params.name: working_hour_label_id
params.description: Filter by specific working hour label

params.name: working_hour_source
params.description: Filter by source of working hours

params.name: slot_length
params.description: Manually specify slot length in minutes. Defaults to 15 minutes

params.name: slot_interval
params.description: Manually specify the time in minutes between returned slot start times when a contiguous opening exists longer than the slot_length

params.name: overlapping_operatory_slots
params.description: Return all available slots for operatories at a given time instead of returning only the first found. Default is false

params.name: appointments_per_timeslot
params.description: Number of appointments (default:1, max:5) that can be booked in a single slot. Only supported for eClinicalWorks and NextGen.

params.name: operatory_ids[]
params.description: Specify this if booking is mapped to operatory in this location

items.docs: This endpoint returns the bookable slots for the requested locations over the given date range, computed from provider availabilities and existing appointments. At least one of pids or appointment_type_id must be provided.
